verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a server that connects publishers to subscribers, so a machine-readable API or protocol spec is a fair question for it. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path, and nothing in the docs mentions a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file is a docs index for LLMs, an adjacent feature rather than an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
